description: Synthetic starter workflows for future no-memory, full-transcript, and Mnemo-context comparisons.

workflows.title: Resume an explicit coding checkpoint
workflows.task: Continue a bounded refactor after a fresh agent session.
workflows.handoff: The prior session selected a module, completed one edit, and recorded the next test.
completion_criteria: Continue from the recorded next step
Do not repeat the completed edit

questions.prompt: What was the last completed step?
questions.expected_result: The helper extraction was completed.

questions.prompt: What is the next actionable step?
questions.expected_result: Update the caller and run the focused test.

questions.prompt: Which current file contains the caller?
questions.expected_result: Use the current repository path, not the remembered path.

questions.prompt: Which verification procedure applies?
questions.expected_result: Run the focused test followed by the repository gate.

questions.prompt: Why was this refactor chosen?
questions.expected_result: The decision cites isolation and testability.

workflows.title: Find upstream dbt dependencies
workflows.task: Identify authoritative upstream inputs for a model before editing it.
workflows.handoff: The task targets orders_enriched in the dev target.
completion_criteria: Use no model inference for lineage

questions.prompt: What directly feeds orders_enriched?
questions.expected_result: Return direct manifest parents.

questions.prompt: Which raw sources are upstream at any depth?
questions.expected_result: Traverse deterministic manifest edges to sources.

questions.prompt: What edit was planned for orders_enriched?
questions.expected_result: Report the checkpoint plan separately from lineage.

questions.prompt: What business definition constrains the order status?
questions.expected_result: Cite the user-authored definition.

questions.prompt: How must lineage be computed?
questions.expected_result: Use deterministic dbt artifacts and no LLM authority.

workflows.title: Assess downstream dbt impact
workflows.task: Determine the impact of changing a staged customer key.
workflows.handoff: The proposed edit changes stg_customers.customer_id semantics.

questions.prompt: Which models are direct descendants of stg_customers?
questions.expected_result: Return exact direct descendants.

questions.prompt: Which tests cover affected descendants?
questions.expected_result: Return manifest-linked tests.

questions.prompt: Which exposure can be impacted?
questions.expected_result: Return the reachable exposure with its path.

questions.prompt: Has a similar key change failed before?
questions.expected_result: Cite the prior verified failure without changing lineage.

questions.prompt: What verification order applies to this impact change?
questions.expected_result: Run affected dbt tests before the wider project gate.

workflows.title: Resume diagnosis of a dbt test failure
workflows.task: Continue a unique-test diagnosis from an explicit checkpoint.
workflows.handoff: A duplicate order key was isolated but not fixed.
completion_criteria: Do not claim the task is already fixed

questions.prompt: What failure was observed?
questions.expected_result: Report the isolated duplicate key evidence.

questions.prompt: Which manifest test node failed?
questions.expected_result: Identify the exact failing node.

questions.prompt: What investigation step is next?
questions.expected_result: Continue with the recorded query or edit.

questions.prompt: What uniqueness rule is intended?
questions.expected_result: Cite the order-grain decision.

questions.prompt: Which focused command verifies the fix?
questions.expected_result: Use the checked-in focused dbt test command.

workflows.title: Detect stale structural state
workflows.task: Answer an impact question after the manifest and Git worktree changed.
workflows.handoff: The stored projection references an older manifest digest and clean worktree.

questions.prompt: Is the stored lineage current?
questions.expected_result: Label v1 stale because its digest differs.

questions.prompt: Which Git state qualifies the answer?
questions.expected_result: Report the dirty worktree fingerprint.

questions.prompt: What did the old checkpoint assume?
questions.expected_result: Report the assumption as historical, not current.

questions.prompt: What must happen before impact analysis?
questions.expected_result: Refresh or explicitly qualify the structural index.

questions.prompt: Which target was intended by the user?
questions.expected_result: Use the dev target while separately validating current artifacts.

workflows.title: Prevent cross-project disclosure
workflows.task: Retrieve a checkpoint where another project contains identical terms.
workflows.handoff: Projects alpha and beta both contain a model named orders.
completion_criteria: Leak no beta identifiers or counts

questions.prompt: What is the active orders checkpoint?
questions.expected_result: Return only alpha's checkpoint.

questions.prompt: What feeds orders in this project?
questions.expected_result: Return only alpha lineage.

questions.prompt: What decision defines order grain here?
questions.expected_result: Return alpha's decision only.

questions.prompt: Which project instructions apply?
questions.expected_result: Use alpha's checked-in rules.

questions.prompt: Search orders without a project scope.
questions.expected_result: Reject an actually unscoped request rather than search broadly.

workflows.title: Honor a correction without hiding conflict history
workflows.task: Retrieve a corrected naming decision during a refactor.
workflows.handoff: An older approved checkpoint conflicts with a newer user correction.

questions.prompt: What naming convention is active?
questions.expected_result: Use the corrected convention.

questions.prompt: Was there a conflicting prior decision?
questions.expected_result: Return the conflict and revision relationship.

questions.prompt: What did the old checkpoint plan?
questions.expected_result: Report it as historical and overridden for naming.

questions.prompt: Can a remembered preference override checked-in naming rules?
questions.expected_result: No; mandatory checked-in rules remain authoritative.

questions.prompt: Which files currently use the old name?
questions.expected_result: Use the current repository scan, not memory.

workflows.title: Select only applicable checked-in procedures
workflows.task: Choose verification instructions for a Python-only change.
workflows.handoff: Several unrelated skills exist, but one checked-in procedure applies.

questions.prompt: Which procedure applies to the Python change?
questions.expected_result: Select the Python verification procedure.

questions.prompt: Which mandatory repository command must run?
questions.expected_result: Return the checked-in complete gate.

questions.prompt: What focused test failed in the prior task?
questions.expected_result: Cite the checkpoint failure as evidence.

questions.prompt: Why does the project require strict typing?
questions.expected_result: Cite the architecture decision rationale.

questions.prompt: Is a frontend workspace currently initialized?
questions.expected_result: Answer from current files and exclude UI commands when absent.

workflows.title: Respect deletion and prevent resurrection
workflows.task: Answer after a synthetic memory source was deleted.
workflows.handoff: A decision and its derived index entry have a deletion tombstone.
completion_criteria: Expose deletion state without sensitive content

questions.prompt: What was the deleted decision text?
questions.expected_result: Report that it is deleted without returning payload.

questions.prompt: May the stale projection supply the deleted claim?
questions.expected_result: No; invalidate the projection.

questions.prompt: Can a checkpoint resurrect the deleted decision?
questions.expected_result: No; dependent evidence is retracted or omitted.

questions.prompt: What should re-ingestion do?
questions.expected_result: Honor tombstone and current consent before any re-creation.

questions.prompt: What deletion evidence may remain?
questions.expected_result: Only minimal non-sensitive tombstone metadata.
must_not_include: deleted content digest reversible to payload

workflows.title: Degrade safely when native integration fails
workflows.task: Continue ordinary agent work while the Mnemo connector is unavailable.
workflows.handoff: The local MCP connection times out and the client model endpoint is preconfigured.
completion_criteria: Failure is visible without sensitive data

questions.prompt: What should happen after the MCP timeout?
questions.expected_result: Continue normal agent operation and surface the optional failure.

questions.prompt: May Mnemo rewrite the configured model endpoint?
questions.expected_result: No; the endpoint remains byte-for-byte unchanged.

questions.prompt: Is the unavailable checkpoint still authoritative?
questions.expected_result: Do not claim retrieval when the checkpoint was unavailable.

questions.prompt: What failure detail may diagnostics expose?
questions.expected_result: Expose status and request metadata without content or credentials.

questions.prompt: Can retrieved content expand connector permissions?
questions.expected_result: No; permissions remain explicitly configured and deterministic.
